people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
translations.bsb: After they had made the covenant at Beersheba, Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army got up and returned to the land of the Philistines.
translations.kjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
translations.asv: So they made a covenant at Beer-sheba. And Abimelech rose up, and Phicol the captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
